source_title: facebookincubator/muse-gadget-sdk: Open source SDK to build Muse gadgets - GitHub
source_excerpt:
Muse gadgets are open source devices you build yourself. Program an off-the-shelf ESP32 board or set up a Raspberry Pi with our device SDKs, then connect Muse to your displays, buttons, sensors, actuators, and whatever else you've got lying on your workbench.
We open sourced the SDKs and firmware here. It's built by hackers, for hackers, just for fun. Side effects of tinkering may include bricked boards, voided warranties, brownouts, or bankruptcies. Proceed at your own risk!
Before you flash or pair a gadget, get an SDK token and review the Gadget SDK Terms . Every gadget needs a token to pair.
ESP32 and Linux gadgets pair with the Muse app on iOS and Android, via Settings > Devices. Turn on Developer mode there first, then look for devices prefixed with "MuseGadget". Each directory has a README.md to get started and an AGENTS.md for coding agents like Muse Code .
For battery-input power profiling, see the porting recipe . The opt-in diagnostic core is board-neutral; boards supply its hooks and state matrices, and power_sweep.py drives the USB-free sweep. The isolated diagnostic does not pair or need an SDK token; fixture safety and explicit hardware authorization still come first, as the PPK2 rules describe.
Meet other hackers who are building and customizing Muse gadgets in our community Discord . Get inspired, support each other, and share what you make.

Dependencies fetched at build time are under their own licenses: ESP-IDF components (into esp32/managed_components/ ), and the simulator's LVGL and SDL (listed in esp32/simulator/THIRD_PARTY.md ).
The Apache License does not cover the Jollybot avatar .
Muse Gadgets Test's sample clips aren't in this repository: the app fetches a few seconds of the Blender Foundation's open movies (CC BY 3.0) when one is played, and shows their credits.
Muse Gadgets Test can use x264 (GPL-2.0) on the phone; this repository carries none of its code. An APK or iPhone app you build with it is under the GPL ( android/musegadgetstest/README.md , ios/musegadgetstest/README.md ).
